title: Verona Home: made-to-order furniture, replatformed on Shopify
answerBlock: Verona Home is a California furniture brand selling made-to-order pieces direct to its customers, and its store was stuck on a page builder. We replatformed it on Shopify with a configurator for made-to-order pieces. The new store took $2.4M in its first year, add to cart rose 68% and the largest content on a mobile page loads in 1.4s.
summary: A furniture brand stuck on a page builder, replatformed with a configurator for made-to-order pieces.

seo.title: Verona Home: Shopify replatform case study
seo.description: How Verona Home left a page builder for Shopify with a configurator for made-to-order furniture, and took $2.4M in its first year.

cover.alt: A warehouse floor lined with shelving, cartons and yellow crates ready for dispatch

challenge: Verona Home sells furniture that is made to order, so a buyer has choices to make before they commit to a piece. Its store had been built with a page builder, and the page builder set the limits of what the store could do.
A page builder is designed for arranging pages, not for products that are configured before they are bought. For a made-to-order range, the choosing is the part of the purchase that matters most.
approach: We moved the store off the page builder and onto Shopify, so the catalogue, checkout and orders sit on a platform built for commerce rather than on a layout tool.
The configurator was the centre of the brief. A customer choosing a made-to-order piece should see their choices come together before they add it to the cart, not after.
build: The store runs on Shopify, with a configurator for made-to-order pieces built into the product pages.
Speed on a phone was treated as a requirement from the start, not a finishing touch. The largest content on a mobile page loads in 1.4s.

gallery.alt: A green velvet sofa on a pale wooden floor against a white wall
A yellow armchair beside a brass floor lamp in a living room
A grey tufted sofa with teal cushions in a bright living room

outcome: In its first year on the new store, Verona Home took $2.4M in revenue. Add to cart rose 68%.
Mobile largest contentful paint is 1.4s, so a shopper browsing on a phone sees the piece they tapped on without waiting for it.
measurement: Commercial figures come from the client's own analytics, twelve months after launch, and every figure is one the client agreed to publish. Speed and accessibility results, such as load times, Lighthouse scores and WCAG conformance, are measured on the live site.
